# Toggle Switch

```tsx
import { ToggleSwitch } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

Toggles a setting on or off. Mirrors the Figma Toggle Switch component: State (Default / Read Only / Disabled) × Active × Show Label × Label Position.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<ToggleSwitch
  {...args}
  onCheckedChange={(checked, details) => {
    updateArgs({ checked })
    args.onCheckedChange?.(checked, details)
  }}
/>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Toggle Switch component:
- State: Default, Read Only (`readOnly`), Disabled (`disabled`)
- Active (`checked`)
- Show Label / Label Position / Description as props Default is a 44 × 24px pill with a 3px inset: Background/Disabled/Strong off, Background/Accent/Strong on, and an 18px Icon/On Color button with the Shadows/X-Small shadow. Read Only and Disabled are outlined instead (2px Icon/Read Only or Icon/Disabled) with a 14px button in the same color. Neither can be changed, so they have no Focus and leave the tab order.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`ToggleSwitch`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Label" (Show Label). Without it only the toggle renders. |
| `description?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Description" (Show Description). |
| `labelPosition?` | `"right" \| "left"` | Figma "Label Position". |

## Rules

- Import `ToggleSwitch` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
